build_swin_backbone: build a pretrained Swin-Large backbone model for MiDaS depth estimation using timm
create_swinl12_model: create a Swin-Large patch4 window12 384 model with optional custom hook indices
review_swin_hooks: review the Swin backbone hook registration that captures activations from all four model layers
summarize_swin_backbone: summarize the Swin backbone postprocessing modules that transpose and unflatten activation tensors
test_swin_forward: test the Swin backbone forward pass by running input tensors through the pretrained model
